description.zh: 用浏览器原生 View Transitions API 在页面状态切换时做平滑过渡：旧视图淡出、新视图淡入，关键元素可共享形变。它把状态跳变藏进连续的空间叙事，让"换了一屏"读起来像"移了一步"，而不是硬切。
description.en: A browser-native transition between page states via the View Transitions API: the old view fades out, the new one fades in, and key elements can morph as shared targets. It hides the jump inside continuous spatial narrative so "a new screen" reads as "one step over" rather than a hard cut.

use_when.zh: 同文档内状态或路由切换需要连续感（列表↔详情）
use_when.en: In-document state or route changes needing continuity — list to detail

use_when.zh: 存在应保持视觉连续的关键元素（标题、图片、按钮）
use_when.en: Key elements that should persist visually — titles, images, buttons

use_when.zh: 目标浏览器已支持 View Transitions API
use_when.en: Target browsers already support the View Transitions API

avoid_when.zh: 每次切换都播长动画，高频导航会被拖慢
avoid_when.en: Long animations on every hop — frequent navigation bogs down

avoid_when.zh: 旧新视图结构差异过大，形变会扭曲内容
avoid_when.en: Old and new views differ wildly — morphing distorts content

avoid_when.zh: 需要兼容无 API 环境且不愿做回退分支
avoid_when.en: Must support no-API environments without a fallback path

note.zh: 旧淡出新淡入，最稳妥的默认
note.en: Old fades out, new fades in — the safe default

note.zh: 沿导航方向推入推出，前进后退语义清晰
note.en: Push in/out along the navigation axis — clear forward/back semantics

note.zh: 共同元素原地形变，其余沿轴移动
note.en: Shared elements morph in place; the rest moves along an axis

sources.name: W3C — CSS View Transitions Module Level 1

notes.zh: 原生路径用 document.startViewTransition(() => updateDOM())，为需形变的元素指定 view-transition-name。无 API 时用 CSS animation 兜底：旧视图 fade/slide 出、新视图入， 时长一律 calc(<时长> * var(--demo-speed, 1))。尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，退化为瞬时切换。
notes.en: The native path calls document.startViewTransition(() => updateDOM()) and assigns view-transition-name to elements that should morph. Without the API fall back to CSS animation: the old view fades or slides out as the new one enters, all durations written calc(<duration> * var(--demo-speed, 1)). Respect prefers-reduced-motion by cutting instantly.

basic.zh: 给列表与详情之间的切换添加视图过渡动画。
basic.en: Add a view transition between list and detail states.

design.zh: 列表卡片点开时，标题与图片保持视觉连续地形变为详情页对应元素，其余内容交叉淡入，约 300ms；返回时反向播放。
design.en: Opening a card morphs its title and image into the detail counterparts while the rest cross-fades over ~300ms; going back reverses the move.

implementation.zh: 优先用 document.startViewTransition + view-transition-name；无 API 时用 @keyframes 兜底， 旧新视图绝对定位叠放做交叉淡入或滑动。所有时长写 calc(<时长> * var(--demo-speed, 1))。 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: Prefer document.startViewTransition with view-transition-name; fall back to @keyframes with stacked absolute views cross-fading or sliding. Write every duration as calc(<duration> * var(--demo-speed, 1)). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现视图过渡。

先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
要求：
- 状态或路由切换有连续过渡，关键元素保持视觉连续
- 无 View Transitions API 时有 CSS 兜底
- 所有动画时长写 calc(<时长> * var(--demo-speed, 1))
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement view transitions in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing components.
Keep the project's visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Requirements:
- State or route changes transition continuously, with key elements staying visually continuous
- CSS fallback when the View Transitions API is missing
- All animation durations written calc(<duration> * var(--demo-speed, 1))
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.
